homeNew.valueProp: A booking page for your business. Customers pick a service and a free time — no phone calls, no back-and-forth.
homeNew.whoFor: Built for barbershops, beauty salons and small service businesses.
homeNew.howCustomersBook: Customers open your link, choose a service, pick an available time and confirm. You see the booking instantly.
homeNew.howOwnersManage: You set your services, prices, working hours and days off. Bookora only shows times you are actually free.
homeNew.howToStart: Open Bookora in Telegram, create your business, add a service, set your hours and share your link.
homeNew.freePlanBody: 1 business, unlimited services and unlimited bookings on the free plan. No card required. Pro adds multiple businesses.
homeNew.step1Desc: Name, country and time zone — about 30 seconds.
homeNew.step2Desc: Haircut 30 min, colouring 90 min — whatever you sell.
homeNew.step3Desc: Your open days, hours and breaks. Customers only see free slots.
homeNew.step4Desc: Put it in your bio, your window or your WhatsApp status.
homeNew.faq1A: No. Your booking page is a normal web link. Anyone with the link can book from any browser.
homeNew.faq2Q: What does the free plan include?
homeNew.faq2A: One business with unlimited services and unlimited bookings. There is no limit on how many appointments customers can make.
homeNew.faq3A: Yes, optionally. Add a fixed or percentage deposit and your payment details are shown at booking time.
homeNew.faq4Q: How do I know when someone books?
homeNew.faq4A: The booking appears in your Bookora dashboard immediately. Bookora also sends you a Telegram message for bookings that do not require a deposit.

outreach.acquisitionNote: Prepared is NOT delivered. A stage is only counted when a table recorded it; anything else says "no source". Delivered = Telegram accepted the message (or the person started the bot).
outreach.botHelp: Registers the webhook, the command list and the persistent Mini App button. Run this once after deploying, then send /start to the bot to verify.
outreach.botNote: The bot can only reply to people who message it first. For everyone else the dashboard prepares a personalized link for manual outreach.
outreach.botStep1: Open @BotFather in Telegram and confirm the bot token in TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN belongs to this bot.
outreach.botStep2: Add TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET (32+ characters) to the Vercel environment variables and redeploy.
outreach.botStep3: Press the configure button above again, then open the bot and send /start.
outreach.campaignApproved: Campaign approved. Nothing has been sent yet.
outreach.campaignsHelp: One campaign per city and segment, so results stay attributable. Dry run, then approve, then prepare — nothing is sent without approval.
outreach.channelUrlMissing: not configured yet — add the real channel link in Discovery settings
outreach.citiesHelp: Only administrator-approved markets appear here. Leave empty to target all verified prospects; reports always group by each city separately.
outreach.configureBot: Configure webhook, commands and Mini App button
outreach.destBot: Bookora bot link (unique start code per recipient)
outreach.destBotUrl: bot deep link — one unique start code per recipient
outreach.destOther: Other destination (website, WhatsApp contact, booking page…)
outreach.destinationsTitle: Links to include (nothing is inserted unless you select it)
outreach.discoveryHelp: Discovery and preparation limits, not delivery guarantees. The system never raises these on its own.
outreach.dryRunDone: Dry run complete. No message was sent.
outreach.funnelSubtitle: Anonymous counts. No IP, user agent or personal data is stored.
outreach.keywordsHelp: Matched against public business names, usernames and descriptions from the sources you configure below. Telegram cannot be searched for users — this is not a Telegram user search.
outreach.marketsHelp: Up to 100 markets can be registered. Outreach NEVER auto-expands: a city becomes targetable only after you approve it here, one by one.
outreach.marketsSafety: Approving a market enables campaign targeting only. It creates no prospects, starts no sending and sends nothing.
outreach.marketsSearchPlaceholder: Filter markets by name, code or region…
outreach.messageBuilderHelp: Edit the invitation text, pick the links, preview the EXACT message, then save. The message freezes after approval, like targeting.
outreach.messageTextHelp: Allowed placeholders (in curly braces): businessName, link and category. The message must contain at least one link.
outreach.messageTextPlaceholder: Write the invitation here — see the live preview below.
outreach.noApprovedCities: No approved cities yet — approve markets first.
outreach.noRuns: No scheduled run has completed yet.
outreach.noTemplates: No templates yet. Add one above.
outreach.objectivePlaceholder: What should this campaign prove or achieve?
outreach.prepareHelp: Creates drafts only. Nothing is sent until you approve an invitation, and automated delivery only reaches people who already started the bot.
outreach.previewFinal: Preview — exactly what preparation will send
outreach.previewNote: Identical to the prepared message; only the bot link's start code differs per recipient.
outreach.prospectsHelp: Only add businesses whose public page you have seen yourself. Store the public name and the public profile URL — never private contact details.
outreach.seedHelp: One per line: Name | https://public-url | City. Only paste pages you have verified yourself — this is the authorized way to feed discovery.
outreach.templatesHelp: Use {businessName}, {link} and {category}. Every template must contain {link}.
outreach.verificationEvidencePlaceholder: What proves the city and category?
